newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Taiwan's CPC tenders to sell diesel for Nov 11-30.
newsitem.headline: Taiwan's CPC tenders to sell diesel for Nov 11-30.

text.p: Taiwan's state-owned Chinese Petroleum Corp (CPC) has issued a tender to sell 225,000-250,000 barrels of 0.3-percent sulphur diesel for November 11-30 lifting on a free-on-board (fob) basis from Kaohsiung, a CPC source said on Tuesday.
The preferred lifting periods are November 11-15, November 18-22 or November 25-29, the source said.
The tender closes on October 15 with bids valid until November 17.

In its last tender, CPC sold two 225,000-to-250,000-barrel cargoes of 0.3-percent sulphur diesel to a Singapore trader and a Swiss trader at just under $27.00 per barrel for October 1-23 lifting, fob Kaohsiung.
